profile.subtitleJa: ダビデとともに渡る人
profile.summaryJa: サムエル記下19:37で、バルジライはダビデに「あなたの僕キムハム」を連れて行くよう願います。本文はここでキムハムをバルジライの息子とは明記しません。
profile.identityNoteJa: バルジライとの関係は本文上「あなたの僕」とされる。親子関係は断定しない。

facts.textJa: バルジライはキムハムを王とともに渡らせるよう願います。
キムハムは王とともにギルガルへ渡ります。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”
The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”
So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.
